title: The Oil That Did Not Stop
themeTags: a little becomes more than enough
reflectionQuestion: The woman had only one little jar, but she trusted God, and he filled every empty jar in the house. I wonder what you could bring to God, even when it feels like only a little?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor elisha_widow_oil (Elijah & Elisha). Phase 2 'Beloved' / toward-100. WATCH-ITEM: the mother's trouble (widowed, in debt, creditor would take her sons) kept GENTLE -- 'a poor mother, so worried... owed money she could not pay'; the sons-as-servants threat omitted. The overflowing-oil wonder is the joy (fills every jar). Room = bring God your empty jars / a little + trust becomes more than enough / God provides in trouble. Distinct from 1880-area feeding miracles (this is the oil-overflow). Soft close ('brim'). VOICE_HANNAH_HOPE (warm, hopeful female; LYDIA_GRACIOUS was banned).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
